_comment: Edit me. Read by scripts/triage_score.py. Keys you omit fall back to the script defaults. score = 100 * weighted_mean(impact, asset_criticality, spread, data_sensitivity)/5 * (confidence/5)^confidence_exponent. Floors fire when every listed factor is >= the value; ceilings fire when every listed factor is <= the value. See references/severity-matrix.md.

tiers.name: P1
tiers.label: Critical: page on-call, incident commander now

tiers.name: P2
tiers.label: High: work immediately, escalate to tier 2 / IR

tiers.name: P3
tiers.label: Medium: work this shift, tier 1 owns

tiers.name: P4
tiers.label: Low: queue, tune, or close with note

floors.reason: confirmed business-critical impact is always P1
confirmed activity on a crown-jewel asset is never below P2
likely-true activity touching regulated data has notification clocks attached
plausible org-wide spread needs coordination regardless of per-host impact

ceilings.reason: a probable false positive should be tuned, not escalated
blocked before execution with no confirmation is a tuning task, not an incident
